Meet The Team

Management

Ali - CEO & Founder

Ali is the Program Leader 👨‍🏫 for the Creative Media Department at University College Kensington 🏫.

During the day he leads & lectures for the undergraduate Computer Games Design 🎮 course. He has more than 15 years of experience and has worked on many different projects with many different companies such as Siemens, London Underground and Royal Air Force (RAF). In the eyes of his 12 year old nephew, he’s the coolest uncle in the world 😎, because he makes games! One day his nephew (who was 9 years old at the time) asked to learn games design. He was surprised 😮 to see how quickly his nephew learnt the same tools his adult students use. “You’re a lot more capable than I thought!” he said. He then taught the same techniques to his 8 years old niece who also learnt just as quick. This gave him the idea 💡 to set up Software Academy, so kids as young as 6 can start learning how to code 💻 and make 3D games.

Saeed - Operations Manager

Saeed has Master’s degree 🎓 in Digital Media Design from the University of Edinburgh (👀 number 16 in world's university ranking!🌎).

Saeed was a lecturer 👨🏻‍🏫 on the games design course at West Herts College 🏫 Now he is our Operations manager, the go to guy for any problem parents and tutors may face! He is our own version of Superman always ready for action!🎮 Saeed enjoys sports 🏃🏻 & music 🎵. He’s described as a dedicated manager by all of our staff!

Sam - Head of Finance & HR

1000 more rows at the bottom Samane holds a First-Class Degree in Pharmacology 🎓 and has experience working in pharmacy.

However, her passion for education ❤📚 led her to pursue a teaching career. She also holds a PGCE in Education for secondary schools and colleges. With over 10 years of experience teaching Chemistry 🧪 and Maths ➗ in various schools, including outstanding ones, Samane is highly skilled in supporting SEND children and high-ability students 🌟. She has always been loved by her students 💙 for her dedication and teaching style. Currently, she is part of Software Academy as our Head of Finance 💰 and SENCO 🏫, continuing her mission to make a difference in education! 🚀✨

Marjan - Qualification Manager

Marjan is our Head of Qualification Management, she graduated with a 🎮 Computer Games Design and Development Diploma 🎓

She specialised in Unreal Engine and 3ds Max. Marjan has always worked with young children through her teaching in Primary schools and Private tuition👩🏻‍🎓. She loves Persian music 🎵 skiing in Switzerland🎿 and world foods!🍣 🥘

Student & Parent Support Team

Jane - Assistant Manager

Before returning to the UK, Jane worked as an international teacher overseas 🇯🇵 and has now been with the Academy for two years.

In her current role, her focus is ensuring our tutors 🧑‍🏫 receive the support they need to flourish while assisting management with larger operations.📋 At heart, I will always be a teacher, and she is dedicated to ensuring that both our students and teaching staff have the resources and guidance they need to succeed.

Marley - Admin Supervisor

Marley graduated with a Bachelor’s in Games Art 🎮 from the University of Huddersfield.

She has a background with freelancing in graphics design, web design and development, illustration and 3D modelling 🖌️. She is currently enjoying learning how to code ⌨️ for games whilst creating her own passion project games in her spare time. She loves playing games as well as making art for them and aside from her time spent on the computer she loves reading and hiking with her dog 🐶!

Ciara - Admin Supervisor

Ciara graduated with a degree in Illustration 🎓 with a concentration in Concept Art for Games and Animation from Savannah College of Art and Design in the United States.

She is a published children’s book illustrator 🎨 with a proficient understanding of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and creating Animated GIFS. Ever since a young age, Ciara has used digital platforms as a means to create artwork and bring to life colorful worlds and characters. 🐉🖌️ When she is not working, you can find her volunteering in Gaming Communities to host safe spaces for tournaments, exploring the United Kingdom, playing cozy video games or brainstorming her own passion game projects! 🌱

Sami - Admin Lead

Sami Graduated from Teeside University in Computer Games Design 🎮 studying extensively in Unreal Engine.

Being lead level designer in his team 🆙️ with extensive knowledge of most recent games especially MMO Sami your go to guy if you want to know what to play next 🎯 in his spare time Sami loves Swimming 🏊‍♂️ and believes he is the fastest in the world 🏆

Aziz - Admin

Aziz graduated with a BSc from the University of Surrey. He starts every day with positive energy and a smile.

He loves Architecture, designing & creating DIY projects, and focuses on Music Production 🎧 🔉. With experience instructing youth athletes, children and adults in health and fitness 🤸‍♂️💪, Aziz strongly believes in building a well varied knowledge base, skills portfolio, and health foundations from a young age.

Catriona - Admin

Cat graduated with a degree in Marketing and Communications 🎓 📚 and has 12 years of experience in Operations and Office Management 🗂️

She also has experience in virtual assistant roles! In her free time, Cat enjoys running ᯓ🏃🏻‍♀️‍➡️ hiking 🏞️ and is an avid reader 📖

Christina - Admin

Christina has a degree 🎓 from the University of Lincoln in Business & Management 💼.

She has had a passion for gaming 🎮 since she was a teenager, as well as a love of everything creative 🎤🎵 ! She has combined her two interests and in her free time creates video gaming content 🎥. When she’s not at her PC, Christina loves cooking 🍳 and is on a mission to make the world’s best lasagna 🍲!

Portia - Admin

Portia is a video game writer who recently completed an MSc in Creative Computing at the University of the Arts London 🎓.

A lifelong lover of games 🎮, she has always been fascinated by the way they allow players to step inside of a story rather than simply watch it unfold. Alongside her passion for writing, she enjoys level design and creating atmospheric environments in Unreal Engine 🎨.  Her spare time is usually spent reading, discovering obscure indie games or trying out new vegan recipes 🌱

Elizabeth - Scheduling

Elizabeth graduated with a first-class honours degree in Game and Entertainment Design from the University of Hull 🎓, specialising in 3D Character Design and Sculpting.

She loves creating intricate (beautiful and sometimes terrifying!) 3D characters inspired by fantasy games and books 🧝. As part of her degree, she completed an internship at a game engine company as an Instructional Designer, developing educational content and learning support materials 👩🏻‍💻.
Elizabeth is an advocate for disability rights, SEN inclusion, and accessible design. She’s passionate about supporting others to grow to their full potential 🌱.
When she isn’t sculpting characters or developing her own indie projects, you’ll find her writing lore for table-top games ⚔️, doing arts and crafts 🎨, diving into a good book 📖 , or enjoying immersive or competitive gaming 🎮✨.

Dana - Scheduling

Dana graduated with a Master’s degree in UX and Interaction Design 🎓 and holds a Bachelor’s degree in Digital Design 🎨. With a strong passion for art and design, Dana loves drawing, painting, and creating thoughtful user experiences through UI/UX design 💻🖌️. She enjoys exploring new tools and is always excited to learn something new 📚.

Dana is friendly and supportive who enjoys helping others grow in confidence and creativity 🤝🌱. In her spare time, she appreciates the simple things in life like a warm cup of tea and a lit candle ☕🕯️, love discovering new places ✈️, and enjoys playing games on her console such as Fortnite 🎮.

Jason - Enrolments Lead

Jason has been crazy about gaming 🎮 ever since childhood 👶 he has previously worked with digital media companies and IT 🖥 engineering

He is looking to hone his skills more with software academy and help develop young teenagers careers 🎓

Ahmad - Enrolments

Ahmad is doing a bachelor's at Kingston University 🏫 . Studying in the field of Computer Science, specializing in Python as a programming language 💻 for over 5 years.

Keen on actively trying to branch out and learn other creative and innovative programming languages 🧠. In his free time, Ahmad loves to play video games 🎮 and playing 🏐. With 3 plus years of experience in teaching Python 🧑‍🏫, Ahmad is looking forward to helping and spreading his passion for programming.

Rod - Enrolments

Rod is a seasoned tech consultant 💻 with a strong background in the software industry, dedicated to helping young people and their parents find the perfect courses in IT, coding, gaming, design, and a wide range of digital skills 🎨.

He understands that every student learns differently, so he focuses on guiding families toward options that match each child’s interests, strengths, and goals 🌟.
His mission is to make the world of digital learning 💬 simple, accessible, and genuinely exciting 🚀 for students aged 6 to 16.
Known for his approachable communication style and clear, practical guidance, Rod helps build real confidence 💡✨ in both parents and students as they begin their learning journey.
He believes early exposure to digital skills sets young people up for success in a fast-evolving world 🌍, and he loves being part of that first step.

When he’s off the clock, Rod is usually out riding one of his motorcycles 🏍️ or relaxing with a good gaming session 🎮, always ready to recharge before helping the next family start their adventure into tech.

Eleanor - Enrolments

Eleanor is a motivated professional transitioning into Software Development 💻, with a background in international marketing and experience as a Treatment Coordinator 🏥.

She brings strong problem-solving, communication, and project coordination skills developed through her work in Dubai and the healthcare sector 🌍. Eleanor is now focused on applying her adaptable mindset and technical training to build innovative digital solutions. ✨

Yasemin - Enrolments

Yasemin is a University of Loughborough graduate with a degree in English, with a special interest in modules geared towards marketing and media in the digital age 👩‍💻.

Her dissertation explored the interesting ways in which artificial intelligence interacts with humanity on personal levels as well as society as a whole. Having experience as a digital marketer, Yasemin understands how important design is through the use of Adobe and other software. In her personal life, Yasemin enjoys all kinds of creation, whether it’s writing, painting 🎨 or experimenting with makeup💄 , she believes that creativity is a gift that all people should delve into one way or another!

Heroes behind the Learning 

Bella - Course Leader

Bella is an animator and illustrator with a BA(Hons) in Animation from Nottingham Trent University 🎓. She specialises in 2D Digital Design using Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects and Premiere.

Bella has been studying 2D design and animation since she was young and loves using software to create fantastical creatures and characters! She directed and animated an award-winning short film 📽, and when she isn’t tutoring, she is usually out bird-watching! 🐦

Christian - Course Leader

Christian is a final-year Games Programming student with a strong passion for mathematics, low-level programming, and game engine development ⚙. Alongside his academic work, he has gained invaluable industry experience during an internship where he contributed to the development of a AAA game, sharpening his skills in large-scale production environments.

He has hands-on experience with Unreal Engine, C based languages, Unity and Python, and enjoys the challenge of solving complex technical problems 🧠 .

In his spare time, Christian enjoys gaming 🎮 — especially chasing platinum trophies 🏆. He also dedicates time to developing his own custom game engine in C++, where he’s exploring systems like rendering, memory management, and physics from the ground up.

Dylan - Course Leader

Dylan is a recent graduate from the University of Staffordshire, where he gained a first-class BSc Games Development (Hons) 👨‍🎓 with over 6 years of experience in Unreal Engine 💻.

He is highly passionate about anything related to games, whether he is creating, teaching, or even playing 🎮! He enjoys plenty of things outside of games too, such as going to the gym 🏋️‍♂️, working on his car 🔧, or jamming to music 🎧. Dylan is also a part of a fostering family who have been fostering and caring for looked-after young people for over a decade!

Jakub K - Course Leader

Jakub has a background in computer game design🎮 and a great passion for teaching🎓 and game development🕹️, with a long experience in both.

Jakub knows Unreal’s blueprint system📘 like the back of their hand and loves to bring students’ ideas💡 to life with it! With their teaching experience, Jakub can help students comprehend and visualize complex coding issues with ease.🔨 Jakub also enjoys games and movies 🍿 in their spare time, and loves the opportunity to combine the passion for design with the ability to share their knowledge

Matthew R - Course Leader

Matthew has been programming since he began studying computer science at secondary school 🏫 and has always had a passion for programming and playing games 🎮 He is a game development graduate with a masters's degree from Anglia Ruskin University 🎓 where he specialized in Unity and C# 🖥️

Having previously worked at a forest school 🌲 while studying, he loves the outdoors and often spends his spare time going for walks and enjoying nature 🌿

Maryam - Course Leader

Maryam is friendly, positive, and determined 🚀. She’s a second-year Computer Science student with a passion for software engineering, cyber security, and helping others learn. She loves solving problems through code and is always eager to explore new programming languages and ideas💡.

When she’s not coding 💻, Maryam enjoys running 🏃‍♀️ and is working towards completing a 10 km race. One of her favourite holidays was to Melbourne, Australia. She loved the beautiful beaches 🌞, feeding kangaroos, and exploring the amazing nature around the city.

Rhys - Course Leader

With over 12 years of experience in the 3D industry 🖥️, Rhys is a master of Blender with extensive expertise in Adobe Substance Painter and Photoshop. Specialising in hard-surface modelling👷, he has turned his passion for recreating intricate UK buses 🚌 and iconic London landmarks 🎡 into a successful professional career. Rhys has produced multiple official DLCs for two leading bus simulators, collaborating with some of the world's top simulation studios.

At the Academy, Rhys is dedicated to translating his industry knowledge into inspiring lessons for the next generation of creators. When he isn’t modelling high-fidelity assets for his latest project, you’ll find him exploring the world of Pokémon or diving into his favourite games and simulations 🎮.

Tarek - Course Leader

Tarek earned a Distinction (First Class!) in his Master’s in Artificial Intelligence 🤖 at Loughborough University London and brings 8 years of tutoring experience, guiding students from Year 1 to A-Level 📚 with energy and precision.

A lifelong coding enthusiast, he’s programmed in Python since secondary school and mastered Java at university 💻. Beyond the classroom, he’s a gym regular and pop-culture fan who collects Pokémon cards, builds Gundam models, dives into Transformers comics, and unwinds with video games 🎮 and anime while sharing smart tips to help young coders level up fast.

William S - Course Leader

Will has been developing games since he was a teenager and has always had a passion for gaming 🎮 and coding . He studied Games Development at Norwich University of the Arts 🎓 where he focused on games development with Unreal Engine ⚙️.

 After he left university he went on to create two games, first one for phones 📱 and the second for consoles and computers 🖥️. He then went back into education at the University of East Anglia 🎓 where he earned his Masters degree in Advanced Computer Science 👨‍💻. Aside from making games in his spare time he also enjoys playing them 🕹️ and tinkering with all sorts of tech! 🔧

Xaq - Course Leader

Xaq has spent many years coding 👩‍💻, and loves every minute of it! 🥰 He graduated Lancaster University with a first class degree in Computer Science 🎓.

He then spent a couple of years learning Unreal and Unity to create games 🎮. Xaq loves games! 😍 Not just video games 🎮, but board games 🎲 and card games 🃏 too, like D&D 🐉 and Yu-Gi-Oh! ❤ If he’s not making or playing games, Xaq will be vibing in his room with a guitar 🎸 or sleeping 😴.

Aaminah - Tutor

Aaminah holds a BSc in Computer Science from Royal Holloway University of London 🖥️.

She is working towards a PGCE (QTS) in secondary computing at Edge Hill University. She has over 9 years of programming experience in Python and is passionate about pedagogy in computing education.

Aaron - Tutor

Aaron is a graduate from Staffordshire University London where he studied BSc (hons) Computer Game Design. 👾🎓

He has a strong focus on gameplay programming and works with Unreal Engine and Godot. 🕹️

Abiye - Tutor

Abiye is a recent Computer Science graduate from the University of Manchester 🖥️.

Beginning his tech journey at 12, creating games on Scratch, he has since gained experience in Python, Javascript & Java, with a particular interest in AI & Machine Learning 🤖.

Agha - Tutor

In his spare time, Imran enjoys hitting the gym 🏋️, hiking ⛰️, painting 🎨, building custom PCs 🛠️. He’s a big fan of gaming 🎮 and socializing, he’s always up for fun and meeting new people!

Alex - Tutor

Alex is an aspiring game developer who began his ⚙️programming journey with Python at the age of 13 and has continued to hone his skills in the language with multiple 🎮games and projects.

He is ⌨️tech-savvy and a quick learner with creative hobbies, such as 🎼music composition and 🧊3D modelling. He also has three years’ experience with entertaining children as a 🎤karaoke and gaming event host.

Asiyah - Tutor

Ben A - Tutor

Ben has a passion for pitching games and has even pitched to XBOX! 🎮 He loves helping people and is skilled in 3D art and Unreal Engine. 👾 He spends his free time swimming ,playing games , and with pets . 🐶

Ben S - Tutor

He enjoys helping students build their coding skills with clarity and confidence, whether they’re just starting out or debugging tricky code 🧩🚀.

She has experience tutoring maths 🧮 and programming 👩‍💻 and enjoys being able to fuel others curiosity and love of learning 📚. In her free time Daisy likes to knit 🧶, play video games, or cuddle her cats 🐈.

Dan - Tutor

Eddie - Tutor

When he isn’t working on games he enjoys movies 🎬 , nature photography 📸 and volunteering as a scout leader ⛺.

Eden - Tutor

Eden is a graduate of the University of Winchester, having achieved a First Class Honours in Digital Media Design 🎓. She is proficient using Photoshop, Illustrator, and the Adobe Creative Suite.

Since then, she has been progressing her skills by creating designs to enhance user experience of games, and even designing a board game of her own. In her free time, she is usually found drawing ✏️, gaming 🎮, or engaging in her next big project 🍄.

Fintan - Tutor

Fintan has been a fixture in the world of game development for over a decade 🎮, driven by a lifelong obsession with how digital worlds are built from the ground up 👨‍💻. He studied Game Development at Abertay University 🎓, where he honed his skills in one of the UK’s leading tech hubs ⚙️.

Since then he has spent the past few hears years navigating the industry as a freelance programmer, solving complex coding puzzles and bringing diverse projects to life across a variety of platforms 💻. Currently, he is channeling all that experience into his most exciting project yet, working toward his first full commercial release 🚀. Whether he’s architecting game systems or refining player mechanics, he loves the challenge of turning a vision into a playable reality.

Goncalo - Tutor

Gonçalo has a deep passion for game design and development 🎮. He thrives on programming in languages like C and Odin, often building game engines from the ground up 🦾.

Additionally, he enjoys working with established engines such as Unity, Godot, and Unreal. Beyond game development, Gonçalo is enthusiastic about robotics and Arduinos 🤖. Gonçalo holds a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Bath. In his spare time, he enjoys playing a variety of games with his friends, with recent favorites including League of Legends 😶‍🌫️.

Hemza - Tutor

Hemza is a Multidisciplinary Designer with 4 years of experience gained through rigorous academic study and hands-on projects in multidisciplinary design. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Art and Design with Creative Technologies from Birmingham City University 🎓 and is currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Architecture, Design, and Visualization at the same university.

Hemza specializes in Blender, with additional experience in After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator 🎨. Passionate about advancing his expertise and sharing knowledge to inspire others 💡, he combines creativity and technical skills to bring ideas to life through visual storytelling and immersive design experiences 🖥️.

Jaber - Tutor

Jaber is a passionate games programmer who has recently completed a Master’s in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence) and a Bachelor’s in Video Game Development.

👾 He aims to create games professionally and teach those who share his passion for programming and game development. 🕹️ He is skilled in C++ and the Unreal Engine, and also enjoys playing the guitar. 🎸

Jack C - Tutor

Jack is a passionate programmer who enjoys building software that people will benefit from. He enjoys solving challenging problems and turning ideas into user-friendly apps.

Alongside his own projects, Jack helps others learn through technology 💻, from supporting people personally to creating interactive learning tools. Outside of coding you can find him climbing 🧗, playing video games 🎮 or reading 📚.

Jack R - Tutor

Jack is a passionate game developer 🎮 from Doncaster who began creating games at a very young age. He works primarily with Unreal Engine and has contributed to a wide range of projects, both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

Over the years, Jack has worked on everything from full game builds to short animated films, blending creativity with technical skill in 3D modelling, animation, video editing, and Photoshop 🎨.
He holds an Extended Diploma in Creative Media Production and Technology 🎓 and is always eager to explore new tools, techniques, and workflows.

Jacob R - Tutor

Jacob is a Games Developer and Designer who holds a Bachelors(Hons) and Masters Degree 🎓 in Computing and Games Design from the University of Plymouth 🌊.

He has experience in Unity 🔲 and Unreal 🖥️ utilizing 2D, 3D, Mobile and Augmented Reality alongside a proficiency in 3D Modelling in Blender.

Jacob T - Tutor

Jake is an artist with a passion for both 2D and 3D art 🎨🖌.

After graduating university with a bachelor’s degree in Games Art 🎮, he devoted his time in discovering how to combine the two and create anime/cartoon style work in Blender inspired by his favourite media! ⚡

James E - Tutor

James graduated with a First Class Bachelor's Degree in Computing (Games Programming) at Edge Hill University🎓🎮. He has worked with a variety of different Game Engines and Programming Languages with his favorites being Unreal Engine, Unity, C++, C# and Python💻.

During his dissertation, James focused on procedural terrain generation in Unreal Engine, exploring systems inspired by the core technologies that power the procedural terrain generation used in Minecraft🌍🧱. Additionally in his spare time James enjoys playing guitar🎸 and was on the committee of the music society during his time at university.

James R - Tutor

Nice to meet you! I'm a BSc Computer Games Technology graduate 🎮 with a passion for game development and helping others learn.

I have developed projects for multiple platforms including PC, iOS and Playstation and have experience across multiple game engines 🤓. I have even developed 2D and 3D game engines  from scratch using C++ and Visual Studio. My main interest is in real time visual effects and particles, I created my own GPU driven particle system in Unity. I also have experience in hard surface modelling with Maya, asset scanning using a LiDAR scanner and developing a pipeline to import these assets into games. I have also developed an educational game about the Spitfire plane used in the Thinktank museum in Birmingham!

Outside of game development, I’m an enthusiastic gamer 👾 with a keen interest in how games are designed. My current favourite competitive game is Deadlock, but my all time favourite is Ghost of Tsushima. When I’m not gaming, you’ll usually find me playing my electric guitar 🎸 or indoor rock climbing 🪨.

In addition to the qualifications 🎓 he has gained in Creative Media, he also has a strong background in JavaScript and NodeJS. Aside from programming, Jaymez also plays instruments 🎵 to pair with his games development projects, as he likes to create his own game music, whether it be by playing the piano 🎹 or a guitar 🎸. Jaymez is always excited to share his knowledge with students!

Jean - Tutor

He started off with python from a young age and instantly fell in love with all things coding, expanding into making web apps for friends and family. Aside from coding Jean loves all sports, specifically rugby and hiking 🏔️. He spends most of his free time building solo projects, playing rugby and making music on his guitar with friends 🎸.

With years of experience as a Maths and Computer Science tutor, he excels at breaking down complex concepts to help students learn 👨‍🏫.
